card.name: Linking words before a medical term
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words (of, or, and, severe, direct, an opening parenthesis) in drug-label and science text, just before a more specific medical or technical term.

modes.label: Linking word before a noun
modes.description: A word like of, or, and, or produce that sits between a phrase and the term it leads to.
